info.title: Roque wallet swap API
info.description: Allowlisted Sepolia beta. EOA exact-input market swaps settle to the authenticated wallet. Conditional trades, smart accounts, delegation and arbitrary recipients are excluded.

post.summary: Read the plan from an approval link
post.description: Requires a separate first-party wallet owner session obtained from /api/auth/challenge and /api/auth/session. The link remains bound to its originating active connection. No application key or caller-provided idempotency header is needed.
